Hi, I'm **Edward Omondi**, a Software Engineer based in **Nairobi, Kenya**, with over 5 years of experience designing, building, and deploying full-stack web and mobile applications. My work spans SaaS platforms, IoT systems, and mobile apps — always with a focus on clean architecture and real-world performance.

My foundation is a **BSc in Mechatronics Engineering from JKUAT**, which gives me an unusual ability to bridge hardware and software — from writing firmware for microcontrollers to building enterprise Spring Boot APIs. After graduating, I've channelled that systems-thinking mindset into full-stack software engineering.

### My Tech Stack

On the backend, I work primarily in **Java** — with Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Jakarta EE, and FastAPI — backed by **PostgreSQL**/MySQL for data persistence, **Keycloak** for OAuth 2.0 authentication, and **Apache Artemis** message queues for event-driven, asynchronous processing. On the frontend, I build with **Angular** and **Nuxt (Vue)**, and ship native mobile apps with **Flutter**, Kotlin (Jetpack Compose), and Swift (SwiftUI). I deploy and maintain applications on bare metal and virtual Linux servers — across AWS, DigitalOcean, Docker, and Kubernetes — with automated CI/CD pipelines.

### What I've Built

I co-founded and built **[Cardly](https://cardly.gift)** — a full-scale Vue/Spring Boot gift card and loyalty platform — and **[Aims](https://aims.homes/demo)** — an Angular/Spring Boot application connected to a Raspberry Pi that controls smart locks for short-term rental units. I've also delivered projects like **[Herdwise](https://herdwiseapp.web.app)** (livestock data collection), a bulk SMS platform for clients in Mexico, an RFID-based points scanning system for an entertainment venue, and a Nuxt/Spring Boot campaign management and donation tracking platform.

### Beyond the Code

Outside of work, I'm a car enthusiast, board game fan, and music lover. I completed my **Certified Ethical Hacking (CEH)** certification in late 2024, alongside an Introduction to Cyber Security certification with Cisco, which feed my interest in building secure, robust systems.
